recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見中型母細胞：核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少呈淡藍，旁邊有一顆小型成熟淋巴球與一顆有核紅血球作比較；在此倍率下細胞質顆粒並不明顯，顆粒型 ALL 的特徵需高倍確認。
features: Intermediate-sized blasts with round nuclei and fine, dispersed chromatin
High N:C ratio with a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules not clearly resolved at this magnification
A second, smaller cell with slightly more condensed chromatin (upper left), possibly a smaller blast
Mature small lymphocyte and a nucleated red blood cell present for comparison
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating intermediate-sized blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm. A mature small lymphocyte and a nucleated red blood cell are present for size comparison. Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules, which define granular ALL, are not clearly resolved at this magnification, and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts compatible with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry are necessary, particularly to exclude AML in a granular blast population.

ddx.vs: Granulated blasts raise concern for AML; MPO negativity and B-lineage markers (CD19, CD79a, TdT) establish granular ALL.
Hematogones and reactive lymphocytes show more condensed chromatin or abundant cytoplasm and are not a leukemic population with cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia (lymphoid)
ddx.vs: Lymphoid blast phase has a background of basophilia and left-shifted granulocytes with BCR::ABL1 fusion.
